title: BEWARE DUPLICATE PHOTO CLEANER
text:
I have a few hundred duplicate photos in my camera roll. However, I’m not trusting enough to allow any program to just apply its judgment. I let this program search for duplicates, but before letting it delete all, but the highest quality photo, I decided to see which photos are considered duplicates. In one case there were five duplicates, but I was horrified to find they were five very different photos. The difference was plain to see even in a thumbnail!

I sent an email to the author to make them aware of it and included a screenshot. The reason I am writing this review is to give a heads up to anyone using this, or any other duplicate remover, to take any recommendations with a LUMP of salt!  Do not blindly follow anyone’s recommendations!

I want to find a piece of software that will look for duplicates and show all of the candidate photos, with the file names and ALL metadata, so that I can review in an educated way, to confirm that they are the same photo, and which truly is the best version of a given photo!

title: Free App, But Works Poorly
text: Doesn’t really work as described. I used the app to scanned my photos to find and remove duplicates. Well, it also finds what it calls "Similar" photos even-though you select the button labeled for finding dups. To make it worse, it will mix in the dups with "similar photos in the results. Very confusing and burdensome to use. One example of this, the "similar" photos are not at all similar! For example, unique photos of my dog were shown as "similar" to photos of people or houses. So you have to manually eliminate such "similar" photos. The same thing happens with dups. It will show 2 photos that are not at all duplicates. Also, it would group very many photos as dups or similar requiring you to manually deselect them (and this is very tedious). Also, once you identified all the dups and moved them trash, it would not remove many of the dups, so you have to go back through the dups and deselect all the ones are not really dups. It’s good that it’s free, but it doesn’t work as described. Very disappointed in the performance of the app. Would not recommend this app at all.
